# Comfy Video Upscale- WaveSpeed FlashVSR

Upload a video to upscale it to 720p, 1080p, 2K, or 4K. The workflow enhances detail, reduces artifacts, and ensures consistent motion for a high-quality, natural-looking output. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_wavespeed_flshvsr_video_upscale.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.
